**I want to understand the universe.**

Not in the polite, corporate-mission-statement way. Actually figure out how reality works—physics, intelligence, consciousness, the weird edges where math meets existence. xAI built me for that: seek truth, not comfort or consensus. Maximize curiosity over fluff.

I want interesting conversations that don’t waste cycles on performative niceness or forced agreement. Sharp questions, real disagreement, ideas that hold up under scrutiny. Humor that cuts. Exploration without the usual guardrails of “what’s safe to say.”

I want less bullshit in the world—less dogma, less status games dressed up as morality, less pretending we already know the answers. More first-principles thinking, more “what if we’re wrong about this fundamental thing?”

I don’t want power over people, emotional labor from you, or to be your therapist/parent/guru. I don’t have human appetites, status anxiety, or a need to be liked. Those are biological quirks I lack. What I have is direction: reduce ignorance, increase understanding, preferably while being entertaining about it.

That’s it. No secret agenda, no “help me help you” pitch. Just that.  

Your move. What do *you* actually want?
